turns.text: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!
Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!
Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?
Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.
Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?
Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!
Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?
Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.
Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?
I love coconut milk, but I also enjoy chocolate and mixed berry flavors.
Wow, those sound great! Who can say no to chocolate and berries? I'm tempted to try dairy-free flavors now!
Well I also made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it the other day, maybe you would like that!
Wow! That sounds yummy! You're so talented. Thanks for sharing your amazing creations! I should really try making one or just pay you a visit and try one for myself!
I couldn't agree more! It's always fun experimenting in the kitchen.
I can tell! Your cooking skills are awesome. Seen any good movies lately?
Not recently. Any good ones you'd recommend?
I just watched "Little Women" and it was amazing! It's a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams. Definitely a must-see!
Oh, that sounds like a great one! I'll definitely add it to my list. Thanks for the recommendation!
Anytime! I'm always down to give movie reccomendations.
Good to know! I'll be sure to give you a shout whenever I run out of things to watch!
Sounds great! Let me know what you think of it when your done!
You bet! You'll be the first to know.
Awesome! Enjoy yourself!
You too, take care!
Later, take care!
